correctness.rationale: Facet normal identities follow by exact Gram inverse, the ridge measure by the signed-root Gram determinant, the dihedral formula by the adjacent two-normal Gram determinant, and the Steiner coefficient by exterior-angle weights / (2π). The central-binomial moment and tail argument justifies the asymptotic coefficient and CLT; an exact checker verified 768 finite ridge instances and 15 classes, including the d=2 V0 normalization.

value.rationale: The standard graph-to-crosspolytope unimodular equivalence loses the Euclidean metric. A full intrinsic ridge area-angle spectrum and exact second Steiner intrinsic volume for the natural star root family therefore resolve a meaningful undetermined geometric quantity, with a nontrivial cancellation producing a sharp -5/(6d) curvature correction. The isolated chi-square distribution is not used as a novelty or value substitute.
